pty17.title: Verify an authorisation
pty17.meta: Ask whether an authority to collect for a premises was in effect at a given moment.
pty17.premisesHelp: Pick it from the public register: type a trading name, a premises record or a ward.
pty17.premisesPlaceholder: Type a name or a premises record
pty17.atHelp: Day/month/year and 24-hour time, no later than now.
pty17.atHelpNow: It is now {now}. Choose a moment no later than this.
pty17.another1: An authority to collect for this premises was in effect.
pty17.yours1: Your authority covered this premises at that time.
pty17.none1: No authority to collect for this premises was in effect at that time.
pty17.recordedLabel: This read has been recorded. Asked at
pty17.wrong: If you think this answer is wrong, contact RightOne support and give them the time of this check.
pty17.checking: Asking the register about this premises and moment.
pty17.askWhy: Choose a premises and a moment first.
pty17.notFound: That premises does not exist in the register. Check the reference, or pick the premises from the list.
pty17.future: You asked about a moment that has not arrived. The moment you gave and the time now are both shown.
pty17.nrTitle: Your organisation is not registered for this check
pty17.nrText: This route is for registered collecting organisations. If yours is one, ask for its registration to be recorded.
pty17.errTitle: This question could not be answered.
pty17.errText: The register did not answer, so no answer is shown. Try again in a few minutes. If it fails again, give RightOne support the reference below.
pty17.unTitle: We cannot check right now whether your organisation is a registered collecting organisation, so we cannot answer.
pty17.unText: Nothing about the premises has been shared. Try again later.
pty18.title: Verification overlap report
pty18.reservedTitle: This report is not open to collecting organisations
pty18.reservedText: This report is for the data owner and assurance. A collecting organisation sees only its own enquiries.
pty18.errTitle: The overlap report did not load.
pty18.errText: Try again. If it still does not load, give RightOne support the reference below.
